subject.title: Feature: Global session reset on auth switch

question: Should OpenClaw add an administrator-scoped global auth-refresh action that preserves active session context, and what session types and credential changes must it cover?
rationale: The request is a new cross-session lifecycle and security boundary rather than a narrowly specified broken contract; maintainers must choose the supported scope and preservation semantics before implementation.

options.title: Sponsor a scoped global refresh
options.body: Define an additive gateway action with explicit authorization, eligible session scope, and context-preservation behavior, then assign an owner to implement it.

options.title: Keep per-session reset only
options.body: Retain the existing session-local lifecycle behavior and document that provider/auth changes require explicit affected-session handling.

options.title: Route to narrower provider-switch work
options.body: Address only a concrete provider-switch flow in a separate canonical issue rather than introducing a general global session operation.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a scoped global refresh
recommendation.body: Define an additive gateway action with explicit authorization, eligible session scope, and context-preservation behavior, then assign an owner to implement it.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied history and discussion place this person closest to the gateway session-reset lifecycle surface.
